rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with a compact ICM and relatively sparse/loose TE, consistent with 3AB. Minor overstatement in claiming no collapse/degeneration from a single still image and limited detail on zona thinning.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, first cycle status, and Day 5 development well with embryo quality and prognosis. Slightly overemphasizes endometrial thickness as a negative factor without stronger contextualization.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, and the implantation estimate follows from morphology plus age/ploidy uncertainty. Minor issues include treating 15 mm lining as a major concern and a few speculative links.

Mostly consistent with Gardner grading and standard IVF counseling, but some recommendations are more opinion-based than guideline-driven, especially the strong concern about 15 mm endometrium and suggesting PGT-A may reduce time-to-pregnancy at age 36 without nuance.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, cavity assessment, luteal support review, lifestyle advice, and future-cycle considerations. Useful and specific, though some suggestions are somewhat generic and not tightly prioritized.
